title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_yoga_o_clonazepam_by_jessica_vega_puch_hu3u4 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_yoga_o_clonazepam_by_jessica_vega_puch_hu3u4' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, clean machine. Removing the package alone does not guarantee removal of all malicious software introduced by it.
